name: Aura Frog
description: Structured AI development with 10 specialized agents, 5-phase TDD workflow, and performance-conscious design. Aura Frog turns Claude Code into a disciplined development team — agents auto-select per task, tests are written before code (RED→GREEN→REFACTOR), and 3-tier rule architecture loads only what's needed (74% less context overhead). Includes 27 lifecycle hooks, 6 bundled MCP servers, git worktree isolation, phase checkpoints with rollback, collaborative multi-perspective planning, and a self-learning system that improves with every session. Zero config required — install and start your first workflow in 30 seconds.
longDescription:
Ships **60 skills**, **16 agents**, **25 commands**, **10 hooks** and **11 MCP servers**.

- **Skills** (60): `agent-detector` (CRITICAL: MUST run for EVERY message), `angular-expert` (Angular 17+ gotchas and decision criteria), `api-designer` (Designs RESTful APIs with endpoint naming, versioning strategies (URL path, header-based), pagination (offset and cursor), error response schemas,…), `bugfix-quick` (Fast bug fixes with root cause investigation + TDD), `chain-of-verification` (Draft → generate verification questions → answer independently via tools → revise), `code-reviewer` (6-aspect structured code review (security, architecture, error handling, test gaps, type safety, simplification) with calibrated scoring and per-aspect…), `code-simplifier` (Detect and simplify overly complex code), `conflict-detector` (L1-L4 conflict detection between a proposed T4 task and pending-confirm sibling tasks), and 52 more
- **Agents** (16): `architect` (System design, database schema, API endpoints, backend architecture), `conflict-arbiter` (Adjudicates detected conflicts between plan-tree tasks), `devops` (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, cloud deployment), `epic-summarizer` (Distills a completed Epic (T2 Feature done) into a permanent_memory.md section), `feature-architect` (T2 (Feature) decomposition specialist for hierarchical planning), `frontend` (Frontend frameworks (React/Vue/Angular/Next.js), design systems, accessibility), `lead` (Workflow orchestrator), `master-planner` (Stateful kernel controller for the plan tree), and 8 more
- **Commands** (25): `af`, `check`, `dashboard`, `design`, `extend`, `heal`, `help`, `mcp`, and 17 more
- **Hooks** (10): `SessionStart`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `SubagentStart`, `TeammateIdle`, `TaskCompleted`, `Stop`, and 2 more
- **MCP servers** (11): `context7`, `playwright`, `vitest`, `firebase`, `figma`, `slack`, `postgres`, `redis`, and 3 more

Installs with `claude plugin install aura-frog@claude-community` from `nguyenthienthanh/aura-frog` (`aura-frog`).
